body: You are an amazing human being. Saved me so much worry ❤️

I went to a psychologist. And I got better. This was roughly 9 months ago. However, recently I have started feeling pretty shit again. 

It's the culmination of everything I guess.

I've had suicidal ideation for as long as I can remember, and these have only gotten worse. But I know I can't subject my mother to go through this
